title: MatSek concept registry (concepts.yaml) v1
description: The document root is an array of concept entries. Two rules JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by the validator: ids are unique across the array, and the graph formed by "requires" edges is ACYCLIC (the retrieval ladder walks it as a DAG). Every id referenced in a "requires" array must itself be defined in the file — also a validator check.

title.description: Short human name, English — the registry is model-facing.

requires.description: Prerequisite concept ids. The resulting graph must be acyclic (validator-enforced).

msc.description: Optional Mathematics Subject Classification code: top level ("26"), section ("26A", "26-XX"), or full ("26A06", "26Axx").

^x_.description: Tool-private extension keys. Always allowed; tools that rewrite the file must preserve them.
